name: Habitas Bacalar
insider_take: This eco-luxury retreat sits on the edge of Mexico's "Lake of Seven Colors," where ancient Mayan mysticism meets modern wellness in perfect harmony.
whats_special: Habitas Bacalar overlooks the stunning Laguna Bacalar, a 42-kilometer freshwater lagoon famous for its incredible blue hues created by varying depths and white limestone bottom. The property features treehouse-style accommodations and operates as a carbon-neutral resort, blending seamlessly with the surrounding jungle canopy.
pro_tip: Visit the nearby stromatolites – living rock formations created by some of Earth's oldest life forms, dating back 3.5 billion years. They're best viewed during early morning when the water is calmest.
dont_miss: The cenotes (natural sinkholes) surrounding Bacalar, including the famous Cenote Azul just 15 minutes away. These sacred Mayan portals offer incredible diving and swimming in crystal-clear waters up to 90 meters deep.
pros: Stunning location on pristine Bacalar Lagoon with crystal-clear waters
Eco-conscious design with sustainable architecture and practices
Wellness-focused amenities including spa treatments and yoga
cons: Remote jungle location requires travel planning
Limited dining options in surrounding area
